title: Buy only what can cross the threshold
summary: Guru Nanak asks the trader within us to choose merchandise the All-knowing Merchant can receive: praise, truth, and Naam rather than visible gain.
takeaway: Test each gain by whether it can travel with the soul.
lifeApplication: Before saying yes to the next deal, upgrade, or status move, pause long enough to ask whether it leaves the heart carrying praise or just another weight.

source.shortMeaning: The worthy purchase is the one the soul can carry onward and the All-knowing Merchant can receive.
source.lifeApplication: At the point of choosing, ask whether this gain carries truth beyond the room where it was acquired.

evidence.coreClaim: The worthy purchase is the one the soul can carry onward and the All-knowing Merchant can receive.
evidence.turn: Let the imagined profit stand before the final threshold, then keep only what can cross with truth.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before saying yes to the next deal, upgrade, or status move, pause long enough to ask whether it leaves the heart carrying praise or just another weight.
